title: Add build --refresh flag
description:
Optional: add explicit `--refresh` to `build`.

From plan §18/§25 Commit 9 — only after the basic implementation works.

- Do not redownload files on every normal `build`.
- Add:
```
completion-dictionary build --profile swedish --refresh
```
which deletes/replaces cached upstream files, downloads latest Hunspell dict + thesaurus, and rebuilds the generated dictionary.
- Implementation:
```python
build_parser.add_argument(
    "--refresh",
    action="store_true",
    help="Redownload upstream dictionary data before building.",
)
```
- Prefer this over a separate `update` command (less CLI surface).

Optional follow-up (skip initially per §19): a `sources --profile swedish` diagnostics command is nonessential — defer.

title: Refactor Profile model
description:
Refactor the `Profile` model to a minimal generic representation.

From plan §15/§25 Commit 7:

Replace WordNet-specific:
```python
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Profile:
    name: str
    primary_spec: str
    fallback_spec: str | None
    default_output_name: str
    doc_language: str
```
with:
```python
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Profile:
    name: str
    backend: str
    default_output_name: str
```
and
```python
PROFILES = {
    "swedish": Profile(name="swedish", backend="swedish", default_output_name="sv-hunspell.dict"),
    "english": Profile(name="english", backend="wordnet", default_output_name="en-oewn.dict"),
}
```
- English WordNet config lives separately: `ENGLISH_WORDNET_SPEC = "oewn:2025+"`.
- Keep the refactor minimal; avoid a generic plugin framework (only two profiles).

Note: Swedish no longer downloads omw-sv/omw-en/cili on build (§16). The `wn` package stays a dependency for the English profile.

title: Update README and attribution
description:
Update README and add third-party data licensing/attribution.

From plan §23/§24/§25 Commit 8:

- Add `THIRD_PARTY_DATA.md` documenting:
  - **Swedish completion vocabulary**: source hunspell-sv, URL, license.

- `pyproject.toml` currently has no license metadata; add attribution/license info where appropriate.

title: Switch Swedish build to Hunspell forms
description:
Switch Swedish `build` from OMW lemmas to Hunspell forms.

From plan §8/§25 Commit 3:

- Implement `build_dictionary(output_path: Path) -> int` in `completion_dictionary/swedish.py`.
- `ensure_hunspell()` → `parse_hunspell_dictionary()` → deterministic sort by `(word.casefold(), word)` → write newline-delimited UTF-8 file.
- Dispatch in `cli.py`: `if profile.name == "swedish": return swedish.build_dictionary(...)`; keep English unchanged.
- `completion-dictionary build --profile swedish` should download/cache (if needed) and write Blink dictionary (`sv-hunspell.dict`).
- Verify resulting `.dict` manually (e.g. `wc -l`, `du -h`).
- At this stage Blink completion should improve substantially.

title: Switch Swedish doc to MyThes synonyms
description:
Replace the Swedish WordNet documentation path with MyThes synonyms.

From plan §13/§25 Commit 5:

- Implement `render_doc(query: str) -> str`.
- Dispatch in `cli.py`: `if profile.name == "swedish": return swedish.render_doc(query)`; English unchanged.
- Desired output:
```
betydelsefull

Synonymer
viktig, väsentlig, signifikant
```
- If several synonym groups, number them (1., 2., …).
- Return `""` (exit 0, no output) when no thesaurus entry exists.
- For inflected forms with no direct entry, V1 returns no documentation (no morphological normalization — out of scope).
- Verify no English content appears (no gloss, ILI, Sense, WordNet metadata).
- In-process `@cache` is fine (per-invocation); parse on each `doc` call initially and measure.
Tests:
- `render_doc("betydelsefull")` contains "Synonymer" and Swedish synonyms.
- Does NOT contain English gloss / ILI / Sense.
- `render_doc("någotutanträff")` returns `""`.

title: Add Swedish Hunspell parser
description:
Add `parse_hunspell_dictionary()` to `completion_dictionary/swedish.py` with unit tests.

From plan §8/§20/§25 Commit 1:

- Create `completion_dictionary/swedish.py` containing only Swedish-specific logic.
- Implement `parse_hunspell_dictionary(path: Path) -> set[str]`.
- Algorithm: read UTF-8, iterate lines, skip numeric count header, strip Hunspell affix flags after `/`, strip whitespace, discard empty entries, deduplicate, return unique word forms.
- Tolerate normal Hunspell syntax (`123456`, `ord/ABC`, `annatord`) → `ord`, `annatord`.
- No CLI behavior changes yet.

Tests (`tests/test_swedish.py`, fixture `tests/fixtures/sv_test.dic`):
- count header ignored
- flags removed
- Swedish UTF-8 preserved
- duplicates removed
- empty lines ignored

Fixture:
```
4
arbete/A
arbetar
arbetade/B
arbetat
```
Expected: `{"arbete", "arbetar", "arbetade", "arbetat"}`

title: Update Swedish lookup
description:
Update Swedish `lookup` to report completion/thesaurus data rather than WordNet senses.

From plan §12/§25 Commit 6:

Replace WordNet-oriented debugging output (senses, POS, sibling lemmas, ILI, gloss) with new-backend info.

Example:
```
$ completion-dictionary lookup --profile swedish betydelsefull
Profile: swedish
Word: betydelsefull
Completion dictionary: yes
Thesaurus: yes

Synonyms:
  viktig
  väsentlig
  signifikant
```

For an inflected word (`betydelsefulla`):
```
Profile: swedish
Word: betydelsefulla
Completion dictionary: yes
Thesaurus: no
```

title: Add MyThes parser
description:
Implement MyThes parser: `parse_thesaurus()` and `lookup_synonyms()` with fixture-based tests.

From plan §9/§25 Commit 4:

- Parse `th_sv_SE.dat` into `word -> list[str]` (or `dict[str, tuple[ThesaurusSense, ...]]` with optional POS).
- Only information needed by Blink: synonyms per word.
- Do not introduce a MyThes executable dependency.
- Preserve synonym groups; a first version that returns groups accurately is sufficient — don't let perfect POS handling delay implementation.
- Fixture-based tests (`tests/fixtures/th_sv_test.dat`, `tests/test_swedish.py`):
  - exact word found
  - Swedish characters handled correctly
  - synonym groups preserved
  - unknown word returns no result
- Minimally valid MyThes fixture.

title: Add source downloading/cache
description:
Implement `ensure_hunspell_source()` and `ensure_thesaurus_source()` using the existing data directory, with mocked/local tests.

From plan §5/§6/§25 Commit 2:

- Keep using the platform-aware data dir (`~/Library/Application Support/completion-dictionary/` on macOS).
- Structure:
```
sources/
├── hunspell-sv/
│   └── sv_SE_expanded.dic
└── mythes-sv/
    └── th_sv_SE.dat
```
- Add a standard-library downloader (`urllib.request`) — no new dependency.
- Pin source URLs/versions in code as constants, e.g. `SWEDISH_HUNSPELL_URL`, `SWEDISH_HUNSPELL_VERSION`.
- Skip download if destination exists; atomic write (download to `.tmp`, then `replace`).
- Add mocked/local tests where practical.
- Networking/parsing details private to `swedish.py`.
